name: Frigorific-Brae
description: Grass-plains and basalt shields alternate across the habitable belt, stitched together by tectonic rift valleys. Farther poleward, past magnetic pole anomalies, the silence feels older than the soil.

Storm season reorganizes all plans. When the pressure falls, animals go quiet, instruments drift, and the horizon turns the color of an old wound. Fossil beds suggest rich seas once flourished here; now the chemistry records only a slow suffocation.
Core samples from the deep crust contain isotopes with no known decay chain. The samples are stored off-world now, and studied reluctantly.
There is money in iron, platinum and medicinal compounds and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
